+class _PycurlResponse:
+    def __init__(self, body: bytes) -> None:
+        self._body = body
+
+    def json(self):
+        return json.loads(self._body.decode("utf-8"))
+
+
+class _PycurlSession:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.headers: dict[str, str] = {}
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    def get(self, url: str, params=None, **kwargs):
+        request_url = url
+        if params:
+            encoded_params = [(k, v) for k, v in params.items() if v is not None]
+            request_url = url + "?" + parse.urlencode(encoded_params, doseq=True)
+
+        curl = pycurl.Curl()
+        buffer = io.BytesIO()
+        try:
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.URL, request_url)
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.WRITEDATA, buffer)
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.FOLLOWLOCATION, 1)
+
+            header_list = [f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in self.headers.items()]
+            if header_list:
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.HTTPHEADER, header_list)
+
+            timeout = kwargs.get("timeout")
+            if timeout is not None:
+                timeout_ms = int(float(timeout) * 1000)
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.TIMEOUT_MS, timeout_ms)
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.CONNECTTIMEOUT_MS, timeout_ms)
+
+            proxies = kwargs.get("proxies")
+            if isinstance(proxies, dict):
+                proxy_url = proxies.get(parse.urlsplit(url).scheme) or proxies.get(
+                    "https" if url.startswith("https://") else "http"
+                ) or proxies.get("all")
+                if proxy_url:
+                    proxy_parts = parse.urlsplit(proxy_url)
+                    proxy_host = proxy_parts.hostname or proxy_parts.path
+                    if proxy_parts.port:
+                        proxy_host = f"{proxy_host}:{proxy_parts.port}"
+                    if proxy_parts.username:
+                        curl.setopt(pycurl.PROXYUSERNAME, proxy_parts.username)
+                    if proxy_parts.password:
+                        curl.setopt(pycurl.PROXYPASSWORD, proxy_parts.password)
+                    curl.setopt(pycurl.PROXY, proxy_host)
+
+            verify = kwargs.get("verify")
+            if isinstance(verify, str):
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.CAINFO, verify)
+            elif verify is False:
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.SSL_VERIFYPEER, 0)
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.SSL_VERIFYHOST, 0)
+
+            curl.perform()
+            return _PycurlResponse(buffer.getvalue())
+        finally:
+            curl.close()
+
